newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sets 19.73 pct coupon on OFZ bond.
newsitem.headline: Russia sets 19.73 pct coupon on OFZ bond.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will pay 19.73 percent, or 98,380 roubles in interest on the second coupon of OFZ government interest-bearing bond (series 24010) on December 17, 1997, the Central Bank said on Tuesday.
The Finance Ministry will pay 37.68 percent, or 187,884 roubles in the first coupon interest on Wednesday.

The Central Bank will also repay the issue, which is not liable to taxation, on a voluntary basis on Wednesday and does not plan further operations with the bond in the future, a Central Bank official told Reuters.
The Central Bank will calculate coupon payments on the issue according to the yields of taxable issues, but the profit from interest payments will not be subject to taxation, he said.
